source_text: Aedificavit Noe altare Domino et obtulit de mundis. Odor suavitatis — Christus oblatio. Benedictio: crescite et multiplicamini. Haec Homiliae II clausula de arca usque ad altare. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Built Noah altar to-Lord and offered from clean. Odor of-sweetness — Christ offering. Blessing: grow and multiply. These of-Homily II closing about ark as-far-as to altar. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered of the clean animals >> Bible:Genesis 8:20]]. The [[pleasing odor >> Bible:Genesis 8:21]] is Christ’s offering. The blessing: [[Increase and multiply >> Bible:Genesis 9:1]]. This is Homily II’s close — from the ark as far as the altar. Amen.
